name: Robyn M. Belinskey
background: Robyn M. Belinskey of Sheridan ran as a Republican for Wyoming’s U.S. House seat in 2022. In her statement for the League of Women Voters of Wyoming 2022 statewide primary voter guide, she said she had worked as a paralegal in litigation matters including land use, real estate, worker’s compensation, and wills and trusts, and that the work had given her a wide-ranging background in law.
